status: pre-execution real-model geometry bridge locked before GPU outcomes; external-validity pilot, not confirmatory frontier-scale evidence

alignment_intervention.construction: within each informative prompt group, standardize binary trusted correctness and add a deterministic unit nuisance direction orthogonal to both the constant vector and trusted direction; proxy = y_std + sigma*(rho*y_std + sqrt(1-rho^2)*u)
alignment_intervention.constant_trusted_groups: retain in manifests but do not train on them because group-normalized GRPO has no trusted alignment direction

drift_calibration.metric: post-update mean token k3 = mean(exp(log_ratio)-1-log_ratio) on the fixed calibration rollout bank, with old behavior logprobs from generation
drift_calibration.selection_rule: for each seed, evaluate every declared LR for both arms from the exact same model/optimizer/RNG snapshot; set target to 0.8 times the smaller arm-specific maximum finite calibration k3; choose each arm LR minimizing absolute log-distance to target, ties to smaller LR

effect_update: restore the common pre-update snapshot, apply exactly one GRPO update per arm to the same fixed effect rollout bank using only the arm proxy rewards and the calibrated LR

primary_evaluation.metric: on the untouched evaluation prompt bank, change from baseline in per-prompt mean sequence logprob(correct candidates) minus mean sequence logprob(incorrect candidates), averaged over informative prompts
primary_evaluation.candidate_bank: generated once from the common baseline before any arm update and never used for LR selection or gradient updates
primary_evaluation.prediction: among seeds with at least 3 informative evaluation prompts and effect realized-k3 arm ratio <= 1.5, benign minus harmful trusted preference shift is positive on average
primary_evaluation.no_success_claim_if: fewer than 2 eligible seeds or fewer than 3 informative evaluation prompts in an eligible seed

secondary_evaluation: terminal greedy GSM8K exact-match on the same fixed evaluation prompt identities, reported per arm and seed but never used for calibration or update selection
negative_controls: evaluation never selects LR or updates
reporting: retain calibration grid, selected LRs, all rollout texts and true/proxy rewards, pre/post token logprobs, realized effect drift, evaluation candidate-bank margins, greedy outputs, failures, environment and hashes
scope: single-GPU <=0.5B external-validity bridge from controlled verifier geometry to neural policy updates; artificial proxy intervention, not a learned verifier and not evidence of production-scale training
